provenance.calculation: The upstream dependency recipe (nix/node_modules.nix) evaluated from the selected OpenCode source with its own locked nixpkgs, so Bun is the 1.4.2 the derivation uses; frozen lock and both upstream normalization scripts. ARM targets use --cpu=arm64 --os=linux/darwin with --ignore-scripts.

verification.x86_64-linux: Native upstream node_modules_updater build; fixed-output hash recorded. CLI and Desktop not built locally.
verification.aarch64-linux: --cpu=arm64 --os=linux replayed through the same derivation on x86_64-linux: fixed-output hash recorded; no native build.
verification.aarch64-darwin: --cpu=arm64 --os=darwin replayed through the same derivation on x86_64-linux: fixed-output hash recorded; no native build.
